verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no versioned public API, such as /v1 or dated versions, and no documented deprecation policy. The closest items are enterprise infrastructure release pinning and canary rollouts (bland-docs-14, bland-docs-29), plus pathway draft, staging and production versioning (bland-docs-19, bland-docs-42). These are adjacent release and content-versioning features, not API versioning with deprecation terms, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
